Question: Which estimator has the smallest bias and best MSE performance in the case of fully observed confounders?
Evidence:
[E1] (figure, Figure 7, page 14) (image attached): Figure 7: Performance of diﬀerent ATETR estimators when true confounders are fully observed. CC and EB outperforms AB in contrast to ATE.
